title: Associated Type Overuse for Polymorphism
pattern: Using associated types when the type needs to vary dynamically at runtime.
why_bad: Locks the type statically at compile-time, preventing dynamic runtime selection.
detection: Associated types on traits where callers require dynamic dispatch (`dyn Trait`) over different concrete type values.
counterexample: Static traits with one unique output type.
fix: Replace associated types with generic parameters on methods.
